purpose: Test on the pinned public SEP-PRISM 24-hour table whether the same fixed model predictions receive materially different skill under ordinary occurrence, episode-normalized occurrence, and genuine new-onset evaluation. This is a methodological external replay, not an operational or state-of-the-art claim.

feature_rule.causal_predictor_definition: All numeric columns from the published current/past 24-hour predictor window, excluding timestamps, direct past SEP catalogue labels OSEP_label/GSEP_label, and every Future_* column.
feature_rule.no_proton_feature_set: joint feature set excluding ProtonFlux_label and every column beginning ProtonFlux_
feature_rule.proton_history_proxy: 1 if published past-window ProtonFlux_max >= 10 pfu, else 0; this is explicitly a past-24h history proxy, not an exact issue-time active-state measurement
feature_rule.missing_values: XGBoost native NaN handling; elastic-net median imputation with missingness indicators followed by standard scaling. No row deletion based on predictor missingness.

models.xgb_no_proton: same XGBoost settings on the no-proton feature set
models.elastic_net_no_proton: same elastic-net settings on the no-proton feature set
models.past_proton_ge10_proxy: fixed binary past-window ProtonFlux_max >= 10 pfu diagnostic

decision_rule.target_for_fit_and_threshold: published Future_OSEP_label, already independently shown to match reconstructed interval occurrence 14,464/14,464
decision_rule.threshold_selection: maximize TSS on each fold's threshold block; if tied choose the highest probability threshold

evaluation.standard_occurrence: all scored rows, unit window weights
evaluation.mapped_episode_occurrence: positive rows uniquely mapped to one physical episode plus all negative rows; standard repeated-window weights
evaluation.episode_normalized_occurrence: same mapped cohort, every represented physical positive episode has total weight 1
evaluation.new_onset: only ELIGIBLE_ONSET_POSITIVE and ELIGIBLE_ONSET_NEGATIVE rows; persistence/ambiguous rows excluded
evaluation.point_results: concatenate chronological OOF score folds and use each row's fold-specific frozen threshold/alert

uncertainty.shared_draws: one set of physical-episode draws and one set of quiet-block draws per replicate reused across every fixed model and evaluation contrast on the uniquely mapped physical-unit sensitivity cohort
uncertainty.ambiguous_positive_windows: excluded from inferential cohort, retained in full-window descriptive standard results

predeclared_primary_contrasts.name: PROTON_ABLATION_ONSET_RANKING
predeclared_primary_contrasts.contrast: joint minus no-proton new-onset TSS, separately for XGBoost and elastic-net
predeclared_primary_contrasts.support_condition: report point difference, paired 95% interval, and ordering-reversal fraction without forcing a directional success criterion

model_level_confirmation_gate.strong: At least two of the three directional mechanism contrasts have paired 95% intervals entirely below zero, including XGB_JOINT_PERSISTENCE_REMOVAL_EFFECT or PROTON_HISTORY_PROXY_PERSISTENCE_EFFECT.
model_level_confirmation_gate.partial: At least one directional mechanism contrast is supported, but the strong gate is not met.
model_level_confirmation_gate.null: None of the three directional mechanism contrasts is supported. Preserve without tuning.
